prompt:
Create one highest-quality, polished native Flutter mobile app screen mockup for a Chinese commercial personal bookkeeping app named 好好记账. It is a single flat portrait screenshot, approximately 393 x 852 logical pixels, rendered at high resolution, no phone bezel, no perspective, no poster framing, no explanatory callouts outside the screen. Exact readable Chinese interface text, professionally spaced.

Use the attached existing app screenshot ONLY as reference for the established 好好绿 identity: warm creamy background #FBFCF7, fresh muted leaf green #76A33A, dark text #1E241C, thin gray-green separators, soft white surfaces, round corners, simple consistent outline icons. Retain the bottom navigation identity and labels 首页, 流水, central circular green plus button, 洞察, 我的 with 我的 active. Redesign the content structure completely.

Composition candidate A: STATUS WORKBENCH. A practical, calm product interface with a clear hierarchy, no decorative illustrations, no fake points or levels, no app recommendations, no implementation explanations.
Top title 我的, a message outline icon and settings gear on right. Beneath, compact avatar circle with 陈, name 小陈, account chevron, and a small current-ledger line 生活账本. Main focal group: section title 运行状态. Two compact clean horizontal rows: 自动记账, green status 已开启, smaller subtitle 保守模式 · 需确认; 云备份, neutral status 未开启, subtitle 保护账本与附件. The statuses are illustrative sample values.
Next section 常用功能 with 全部功能 › at right. Six evenly spaced icon shortcuts in a 3-column 2-row grid, each a simple green outline icon above its exact label: 我的账本, 账户资产, 自动记账, 账单导入, 预算管理, 分类管理. Do not put each shortcut in an individual card.
Next a compact quiet pale-gold membership strip, crown outline icon, 会员中心 and smaller 查看权益与购买记录, right 查看 ›. No sales promises or prices.
Then a shared clean white list with three navigable rows: 备份与数据 with subtitle 云备份 · 本地备份 · 导入导出; 安全与隐私 with subtitle 应用锁 · 权限设置; 帮助与反馈 with subtitle 使用说明 · 我的工单. Chevrons, clear tap targets.
Fit these groups coherently into the portrait viewport with realistic safe areas and bottom dock; avoid overcrowding. Native, commercially credible, carefully aligned typography, body labels large enough to read. No debug buttons, charts, fake loyalty systems, duplicated gear menus, placeholder lorem ipsum, or English UX labels.
quality: Highest quality requested in prompt; tool does not expose model or quality selection.
